records.mutant: replace <impl std::fmt::Debug for ApiState>::fmt -> std::fmt::Result with Ok(Default::default())
records.reason: The Debug text of ApiState is written only into a failure message, and no code path or assertion reads it.
records.evidence: git grep -nE '\{[a-z_]*:\?\}|\?state|unwrap_err|expect_err' over crates/api and crates/daemon finds no formatting of an ApiState whose text is compared or parsed; the impl exists so a holder of the state can derive Debug, and Ok(Default::default()) at std::fmt::Result writes nothing, which changes no return value any caller matches on.
